title: Pocket Golf
pitch: Play six compact holes with a clear aim guide, a readable power meter and physically simulated rolling balls.
rules: Ball must settle before next stroke. Drag defines bounded aim/power; release commits one stroke.
Hole capture requires position and speed conditions. Out-of-bounds restores last safe lie with a declared penalty.
Use Babylon Havok for this app only. Bind one stepping owner and qualify solver settings; do not run Rapier alongside it.
content: Six handcrafted holes, one practice green and per-hole pars. No online leaderboard.
state: ball logical lie at stable checkpoint

actions.phone: Drag aim handle away from ball; explicit cancel
actions.xr: Ray-drag on green, or optional hand controller putter
Natural head view; teleport to preset viewing points

rive.role: Power meter, hole card and animated caddie on a world-space score stand.

polish: Scoring based on actual physics conditions
Nice feedback without screen flash; pause before file actions
tests: One owner steps physics; 60/90 Hz presentation does not double speed.
Save while rolling reports checkpoint semantics accurately.
XR scale does not alter selected putt energy in model coordinates.
loop: accept aim only when ball settled
let the verified Babylon physics scheduler step once
commit stable lie and scorecard checkpoint
save: Checkpoint save at settled lie or completed hole. During roll, Save offers the last stable checkpoint and labels it; XR transitions still preserve live physics.
xr_presentation: Miniature course in AR or VR, not a requirement to walk a life-size golf course.
comfort: Reachable ray aiming and fixed/tabletop viewing. Optional physical putting cannot be the only way to play.
scope: Havok integration is a review gate: the web runtime is distributed under MIT, but this is not a claim that the full Havok engine source is public. See source/licensing notes.
